title: A Drop for the Border
author: Felix Vasquez
blurb: Jonah Reyes, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
